task_description:
# Video Import Overlay

Import actual game footage as background/overlay for the 3D scene. Position players over real video frames to analyze actual plays or plan counter-strategies.

## Rationale
Would bridge gap between video analysis tools (Hudl, Coach's Eye) and tactical planning. Highly complex feature that could be transformative for advanced coaching.

## User Stories
- As a team analyst, I want to overlay tactical plans on actual game footage
- As a coach, I want to diagram counter-strategies directly on opponent footage

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Import video files as background layer
- [ ] Scrub through video timeline
- [ ] Position 3D players over video frame
- [ ] Match field perspective to video
- [ ] Export combined view as new video
